properties.rationale:
Anthony's own words, 2026-08-23: **"Accept it. A parked idea legitimately governs nothing yet."**

WRITTEN IN 2026-08-26, THREE DAYS LATE, AND THE DELAY IS THE POINT. He answered this on 2026-08-23 and the answer never reached the design, so `open_questions` went on reporting it as `status: answered` with the gap still open, and every session since has been offered the same question he had already settled. `loop_status` carried it as "1 answered question(s) never reached the design" for three days. Being asked twice, worded differently, is how somebody learns the tool is not listening — and here the tool had been told and simply failed to write it down.

WHY THE JUDGEMENT IS RIGHT, and it is the same principle this project settled from a different direction three days later. A `proposed` Decision asserts nothing: that is what `proposed` MEANS, and it is why `dec:idea-a-proposed-decision-asserts-nothing-so-what-may-a-structural-detector-say-about-it` (accepted 2026-08-26) now stops three finding kinds reading a brainstormed idea's edges as commitments. An unconnected parked idea is the same fact one layer up — it governs nothing because it has not been chosen, not because anyone forgot to link it. Demanding relations from every idea would add exactly the ceremony the `brainstorm` skill exists to remove.

⚠️ WHAT THIS ACCEPTANCE DOES NOT SAY. It does not say linking ideas is worthless — `review_relations` exists precisely so a session CAN record a relation or an honest "nothing was related", and the count is still computed. It says an idea connected to nothing is not a DEFECT the loop should press the user about. `dec:idea-linking-half-ideas-needs-a-task-that-can-be-run` remains open on the separate question of whether working that backlog needs a runnable task, and this acknowledgement does not settle it.

📌 THE REVIEW EXPIRES BY CONSTRUCTION if the affected set changes, which is correct here: the finding was raised at 117 of 166 ideas and stood at 110 of 192 when this was written. If the shape shifts materially the question comes back for a fresh judgement rather than staying accepted forever on a number nobody rechecked.
